name: gui_build_ocean
description: GB-3 target A (a Tessendorf FFT ocean), from File > New Project > Blank with Studio's GUI only; the shaders are written into the project's shaders/ as a person does in an editor of their own (file steps). PS-1s: h0 runs once (its Schedule picked Once, which makes the image it writes Persistent in the same edit; the frame plan says it ran in this generation and not again 30 frames later, and Recompute runs it again). Every stage is a fullscreen pass into a Fixed 256 x 256 R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT image (Add fullscreen pass, the image's Format picked and Fixed pressed): h0 (Phillips, a hash for the noise), the spectrum at the scene's time (pelicanFrame.time_delta.x, read in the shader: the graph has no way to hand a pass a value), then the inverse FFT as a graph.loop of 16 copies (Count written with its ƒ as 2 * log2(256): RS-15's log2), the carry drawn from the body's output back onto its boundary input. A compute task could not be used: the palette places one with no ports, a shader that declares a descriptor is refused at placement, and ports written later are refused for the unconnected input/output they add. The stage is the copy's element (LC-1s; GB-3 had a branch per stage, each a copy of the body whose pass drew with ocean_fft_<k>): the one body's pass picks ocean_fft from the Fragment list, which reads it with pelican_loop_element() (engine LC-1), and the body pass's band says reads element, its Pass fields that the shader reads the loop element. A displacement pass applies (-1)^(x+y); a render.raster from the palette draws the sea with project vertex and fragment shaders (fragment first: a vertex shader declaring input 0 beside engine://passthrough is refused), its draw counted in the Pass fields (UX-7 decision 4: Grid 257 x 257 pressed, 6 x 256 x 256 vertices with no index buffer, and 2 instances typed into the spin: instance 1 is the sky on the far plane), a new D32_SFLOAT depth image picked in its Depth field and less_equal in the Raster form's depth compare (UX-7 decision 3: the waves hide each other by depth, the sky is drawn where none is), the displacement dropped on its input 0 (read in the vertex stage) and its colour on present's + input. The raster pass is added first: added after the loop it reached the document but the canvas never drew it, because a pick that landed on a pill left that pill's editor open and the canvas waited for it to close (fixed by UX-7 decision 7). Pixels: the sea is not the gradient and not one colour; in edit two readings 30 frames apart agree; Play moves the waves (and one frame differs from a later one); Pause stops them; Stop returns to edit; the run is played again at the end, so Studio's quit comes during Play and has to stop it first (UX-7 decision 9). Typed: the project folder and name, render.raster in the palette's filter, 2 * log2(256) in Count's expression, and 2 in the raster pass's Instances.
